---
title: Run it yourself
description: Clone Najimi, start Postgres and storage, add a Qloo key, and run the app, the worker and these docs on your machine.
icon: Terminal
---

The code is open source (MIT): [github.com/Blockchain-Oracle/najimi](https://github.com/Blockchain-Oracle/najimi).

## You'll need

- Node.js 22.18 or newer, and pnpm 11
- Docker, for Postgres and storage
- A **Qloo** API key and an **OpenAI** key (the agent's answers run on OpenAI)

<Steps>
<Step>

### Get the code

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Blockchain-Oracle/najimi.git
cd najimi
pnpm install
```

</Step>
<Step>

### Fill in `.env`

```bash
cp .env.example .env
```

Only three settings are required: `DATABASE_URL` (already pointing at the local Postgres), `BETTER_AUTH_SECRET` (any random 32+ characters) and `BETTER_AUTH_URL` (`http://localhost:3310`). Add `QLOO_API_KEY` and `OPENAI_API_KEY` for the taste and the agent. Everything else switches on a feature; see [Integrations](/docs/build/integrations) for the full list.

</Step>
<Step>

### Start Postgres and storage

```bash
pnpm services:up
```

Postgres 17 on port 54330 and RustFS (S3-compatible) on 9300.

</Step>
<Step>

### Run everything

```bash
pnpm dev
```

The app on [localhost:3310](http://localhost:3310), these docs on [localhost:3311](http://localhost:3311), and the worker, which applies the database migrations when it starts.

</Step>
</Steps>

## Checks

```bash
pnpm run ci
```

Biome, type checks across every package, and every production build.

## Deploying

Each app has its own Dockerfile: `apps/web` (Next.js standalone, health at `/api/health`), `apps/worker` (with ffmpeg; runs migrations at start), `apps/social-bridge` (Python) and `apps/docs` (a static export served by nginx). `infra/compose.prod.yaml` runs Postgres, a one-shot migration, the web app, the worker and the docs together. Najimi itself runs on a single Coolify server.

<Callout title="Two things to know" type="warn">
Live events use Server-Sent Events: if your proxy compresses responses, switch compression off for `text/event-stream` (or for the web app), or live updates will arrive late. And hotels only switch on with a live Nuitee key; a sandbox key keeps them off.
</Callout>
